{"content": "import RefundCase

namespace Solution

theorem proof : Refund.C_31fecb00c80d90f28032c8918c20cbc10ce18781f1463ef9633e028af599e149.Refute := by
  intro h
  have h1le : (1 : Nat) ≤ Refund.maxU128 := by decide
  have hIn : Refund.InRange ⟨1, 1, 0⟩ := ⟨h1le, h1le, Nat.zero_le _⟩

  have hb : Nat.min 1 1 ≤ 0 := hR.2.2.1
  have hmin : Nat.min 1 1 = 1 := Nat.min_eq_left (Nat.le_refl 1)
  have hpos : (0 : Nat) < Nat.min 1 1 :=
    Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.le.refl : (0 : Nat) < 1) (Nat.le_of_eq hmin.symm)
  exact Nat.not_le.mpr hpos hb
